sources.crackControl: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.3.6.4, Eq 6.6.11 (p. 908): s <= 380 (280/fs) - 2.5 cc and <= 300 (280/fs); one bar: s is the width of the tension face; fs = (2/3) fy permitted; Sec 9.5.3.1, Eq 6.9.1 (pp. 1141-1142): the same for Class C prestressed members
sources.skin: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.3.6.7, Figure 6.6.4 (p. 908): h > 900 mm, both side faces over h/2 from the tension face, spacing by 6.3.6.4 with cc to the side face
sources.flangeTension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.3.6.6 (p. 908): flange tension steel over the effective flange width or span/10, whichever is smaller; Sec 6.1.13.2-6.1.13.3 (pp. 894-895): bf <= span/4 and overhang <= 8 hf (slab both sides), overhang <= span/12 and 6 hf (one side); half the clear distance to the next web is not checked
sources.integrity: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 8.1.12.2 (b), (c) (pp. 1075-1076): perimeter beams one-sixth of the support's negative steel and one-quarter of the midspan positive steel, each at least two bars, continuous (Class B splices: top at midspan, bottom at or near the supports); other beams without closed stirrups one-quarter of the positive steel, at least two bars
sources.shearFriction: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.4.5.4.1, Eq 6.6.66 (p. 931), 6.4.5.4.3 (p. 932): μ = 1.4 λ monolithic, 1.0 λ roughened, 0.6 λ not roughened, 0.7 λ to as-rolled steel; 6.4.5.5: Vn <= min(0.2 f'c, 3.3 + 0.08 f'c, 11) Ac (monolithic or roughened, normal weight), else min(0.2 f'c, 5.5) Ac; 6.4.5.6: fy <= 420 MPa; 6.4.5.7 (p. 933): permanent net compression additive; 6.4.5.9: roughened to about 6 mm
sources.tendonSpacing: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 9.5.3.2 (a)-(c) (p. 1142): bonded tendons at most 2/3, a bar and a tendon at most 5/6 of the Eq 6.9.1 spacing; Δfps in place of fs, at most 250 MPa; up to 140 MPa (a) and (b) do not apply
sources.spacing: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 8.1.6.1 (layer: db and 25 mm), 8.1.6.2 (between layers: 25 mm), 8.1.6.3 (columns: 1.5 db and 40 mm), p. 1068
